steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0021_parakeet_finetune_vs_biasing, t0022_gpu_pb_diagnostic, and t0023_tdt_vs_unified_biasing are completed and locate their result files this task reuses.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: SKIPPED — pure re-analysis of already-collected internal sweep data (Part A) plus a confirmatory inference run reusing an established boosting config (Part B); no new methodology to validate against the paper corpus.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: SKIPPED — operates entirely on local data (t0022/t0023 sweep JSONLs, t0021 checkpoint and eval set); no new external tools, APIs, or facts are needed.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0021/run_finetuned.py, t0021/run_clean_eval.py (apply_boosting, scoring), and t0022/t0023 sweep code so Part A's frontier analysis and Part B's inference run reuse the exact same scoring method and reference the correct checkpoint/config paths.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Plan the Pareto-frontier computation and charts for Part A, and the single fine-tuned+biased inference run for Part B, including which frontier cell Part B will use.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision gpu-azure for the single Part B inference run reusing the existing t0021 fine-tuned checkpoint (no training).

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Part A: compute Pareto frontiers and plots from the existing sweep JSONLs (no GPU). Part B: run fine-tuned + malsd_batch biased inference on the 21-clip clean eval set on gpu-azure and score it.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the gpu-azure instance provisioned for the Part B inference run.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: SKIPPED — both sub-tasks are deliberately narrow and prescriptive (explicit frontier stance for Part A, single reuse-checkpoint run for Part B) with alternative-approach exploration explicitly out of scope per the task's stated constraints.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, and the Pareto/comparison charts and tables for both parts.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: SKIPPED — this task compares internal decoding configs and internal fine-tune/biasing conditions against each other, not against published external baselines.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture session transcripts, mark task complete.
